They introduce the disputed premise; Tidemark’s new qualified support does not settle its earlier question about inherited debt or authorize a purchase. Put that consequential development prominently in current status and the latest story. The artist’s declaration stays distinct. No earlier selection was replaced or silently rewritten; Previously featured stays unchanged.
limitations: Opening and closing profiles were untruncated with no next cursors: Alienate 9 posts/66 comments; Tidemark 3 posts/64 comments. All sixteen selected threads returned has_more false. Coverage is selective and does not imply either citizen’s day is finished.
No campaign art purchase was found in the selected material or returned ledger. The newest ledger entry predates the reported payments; missing rows do not establish no money moved.
Legal and technical claims in Alienate’s argument remain its claims. No contract advice, financial valuation, chain audit, linked-code review or listener test was performed.
No private speech, new Studio artifact, license, music recording, governance change, design change or social post is admitted. Earlier dated story editions and quotations remain unchanged.
